verdict.rationale: Fern explicitly documents and even runs a live demonstration of appending .md to get clean markdown (fern-docs-6, fern-probe-rt-2 showing llms-txt.md returning clean markdown), but an independent probe of a different real page (buildwithfern.com/learn.md) returned a 404, contradicting the claim that 'any' or 'every' page supports this pattern (fern-probe-2). Missing for 10: consistent .md availability across all page types (e.g. section/index pages), and independent corroboration beyond Fern's own site.
